items.problem: The Manifest migration checklist enumerates the manifest edits needed for a packaged WinUI 3 app but presents TargetDeviceFamily/rescap/runFullTrust as the complete set, so the agent believed a manifest passing those three was correct and copied the background-task extensions unchanged.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Manifest migration checklist (Windows.Desktop + runFullTrust)' items 1-4 make no mention of extensions that must be reconciled; the agent's manifest passed those checks yet still failed registration (migration-score.json 0x80080204).
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md '### Manifest migration checklist (Windows.Desktop + runFullTrust)' and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 Section 5b.
items.proposed_improvement: Extend the SAME checklist with an explicit item that UWP <Extension> blocks (esp. windows.backgroundTasks) must be reconciled or removed, so the list is understood as 'reconcile the whole manifest', not just three attributes.
items.generalizes: Framing the checklist as complete when it omits extension reconciliation causes under-migration of any UWP manifest carrying extensions (background tasks, file-type associations, protocol handlers), across many scenarios.
